fields.description: Issue No. 9 (Vol. XXIII) features extensive investigative coverage alleging wrongdoing by Dr. T. E. Moore (described as the “Torture Doctor”) in connection with the death of Mary Jane Korn, including discussion of documentary evidence, police/coroner discrepancies, and calls for renewed inquiry and action by state authorities. Additional content includes commentary on the 1949 season and weather’s effect on tourism, discussion of gambling policy and state politics (including Gov. Fuller Warren), local business and employment statistics, a reader letter about Miami Beach rent increases after decontrol, and brief items on courts/police, entertainment, and other local affairs.
